picks.editorial_note: Berkeley Lab's role leading 13 Genesis Mission projects and partnering on 30+ more makes it the single largest node in DOE's new national AI-for-science push, signaling where the federal government is placing its biggest bets.
picks.title: Berkeley Lab to Lead 13 New Genesis Mission AI Projects

picks.editorial_note: ORNL's selection to lead nine Genesis Mission projects and contribute to 32 others cements the national labs as the backbone of the DOE's AI-supercomputing-quantum strategy.
picks.title: Department of Energy selects ORNL to lead nine Genesis Mission projects | ORNL

picks.editorial_note: NASA's entry into the Genesis Mission, alongside 15+ federal agencies under a presidential executive order, shows AI-for-science has become a whole-of-government policy priority, not just a DOE program.
picks.title: NASA Joins Genesis Mission to Accelerate AI-Driven Discovery - NASA

picks.editorial_note: NSF's $83 million investment in AI-ready data infrastructure addresses a foundational bottleneck for AI-driven science across the entire research ecosystem, not just individual labs.
picks.title: NSF announces $83M investment in integrated data systems and services to advance AI-driven science and strengthen U.S. research infrastructure

picks.editorial_note: Penn State's $20 million NSF award to lead a 'programmable cloud laboratory' node represents one of the largest single grants in this week's news and points toward automated, remotely-run AI science becoming standard infrastructure.
picks.title: Penn State awarded $20M to lead an NSF ‘programmable cloud laboratory’ | Penn State University

picks.editorial_note: Apertus 1.5 pushes forward one of the few fully open, sovereign large language models trained on European supercomputing infrastructure, adding multimodal capability that closes gaps with closed frontier models.
picks.title: Apertus 1.5: Building the next generation of open AI infrastructure

picks.editorial_note: The expanded TUM-MIT partnership, with researchers rotating between institutions and Bavarian government co-funding, exemplifies deepening transatlantic academic collaboration in AI and robotics.
picks.title: TUM and MIT are expanding their strategic partnership in the fields of AI and robotics. The Bavarian Ministry of Science is providing 1.6 million.

picks.editorial_note: RIKEN's AGIS program aims to build generative AI foundation models and autonomous AI research agents purpose-built for scientific discovery, a notable non-U.S. counterpart to the Genesis Mission's ambitions.
picks.title: TRIP Headquarters Advanced General Intelligence for Science Program (AGIS)

picks.editorial_note: A new deep learning model revealing how 3D genome architecture differs in Alzheimer's patients demonstrates concrete AI-enabled biomedical discovery with direct disease-relevance, distinct from the wave of infrastructure-funding announcements.
picks.title: AI, Single-Cell Technology Reveal How 3D Genome Differs in People With Alzheimer's Disease

picks.editorial_note: NEURA Robotics and RWTH Aachen's new 3,000-square-meter 'Physical AI' facility for training humanoid robots marks a tangible step from AI research toward embodied, real-world robotic applications.
picks.title: A Milestone for Physical AI | RWTH Aachen University | EN
